key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:C/Type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_words_then_call
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the base block into a buffer passed on the stack, when that buffer pointer is non-null, then makes one indirect call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:C/Wait:0:0000
name: find_max_and_prepare_buffer
description: Walks a linked list of entries to find the largest value stored in a field, then when a follow-up call succeeds writes a header of incrementing words and copies a sixteen-word block into the new entry. It returns zero on success and minus one when a step fails.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:C/Wait:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_words_then_call
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in the base block into a buffer passed on the stack, when that buffer pointer is non-null, then makes one indirect call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:L/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: validate_disk_bitmap_blocks
description: Writes a status digit into a text line, initialises a table with an all-ones marker, then walks bit positions over a block range comparing two allocation bitmaps and calls indirect routines when they disagree.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:0000
name: clear_block_and_store_globals
description: Zeroes 947 longwords in the global data area, stores two global pointers in fixed slots and then makes one call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:016E
name: open_libraries_and_init_display
description: Opens the graphics and layers libraries and the trackdisk device, loads a font, allocates memory and sets up the display structures. It returns a distinct failure code for each step that fails and zero on success.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:08BA
name: cleanup_flagged_resources
description: Checks bit flags in two stored status bytes and, for each set bit, passes a stored pointer with its fixed size to an indirect routine. It then closes the flagged handles and libraries and clears the status word, which reads as teardown after setup.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:0B36
name: index_six_variable_length_records
description: Makes an indirect call with a size of 920 and a flag of eleven, then parses six consecutive length-prefixed records from a stored buffer, saving each record's start address and length in two tables.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:0BCC
name: open_nearby_door_tile
description: Looks for a tile of code fifteen near a given position and, if found, rewrites the surrounding map cells using a lookup table. It sets a status code and may show a text message, returning one on success and zero when no matching tile is found.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:0EEE
name: setup_main_game_screen
description: Initialises the game screen and sprite structures, computes five buffer addresses, copies a 32-byte palette block and runs a long sequence of setup and state calls. Its text references include strings for a no-arrows message and screen names.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5716
name: step_position_until_blocked
description: Computes the change from the previously stored position, updates the stored position and velocity fields, and when the flag is set recomputes a sector index. It then steps the vertical coordinate upward until an indirect test reports zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:57FA
name: scan_region_table_for_event
description: Scans a table of three-byte regions for the one containing the current position, derives an event code from it and runs the matching indirect handler when the code changes. Some codes set a stored target position from a second table, and others make an indirect call with a new code.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5B1C
name: update_mode_from_table
description: Looks up a mode code in a six-byte-per-entry table selected by a stored index. When it differs from the current mode, it stores the new mode, resets a countdown to three and calls an indirect handler, and it also recalculates a stored counter from an indirect value plus a per-entry byte.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5B9E
name: compute_target_position_with_offset
description: Calls two indirect routines to read values, combines the stored position with an offset of 150 through two more indirect calls and stores the results as a target position.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5BF0
name: place_random_candidate_entry
description: Tries up to fifteen random offsets around a stored target position, stopping at the first candidate that an indirect check accepts. On success it fills the entry at the given index with the position, a type code and values chosen from tables, then returns one; if no candidate works it returns zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5DE0
name: reset_entry_and_apply_effects
description: For the entry selected by a stored index, when its timer has run out and its type is not one of two reserved codes, it resets the timer and marks the entry, then applies a stat penalty or plays a sound by type. It then either adjusts a counter or runs a follow-up routine, and calls one more indirect routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5EAA
name: set_selection_and_reset_fields
description: Sets a stored selection code to six or five depending on whether the parameter is ten. When the parameter differs from the stored selection, it records the new selection and calls two indirect handlers, then positions a pair of fields from a table indexed by a stored counter and resets several state bytes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:5F88
name: reset_state_and_start_stage
description: Resets stored state variables, then either makes one indirect call or sets up the next stage record and its buffers, selecting a display or sound by stage number before the routine finishes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:637C
name: set_paired_offsets_from_parameter
description: Derives several paired offset values from the parameter and a value returned by an indirect routine, stores them into field pairs and calls indirect routines with the results.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:642C
name: select_entry_from_position_state
description: Chooses a table index from the current position range and state flags, then passes four consecutive entries from a table to one of two indirect routines, depending on a flag and the parameter.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:6534
name: track_grid_cell_changes
description: Derives a small grid cell index from two stored position words and, when that cell changes, records it and calls a follow-up routine. It then recomputes two offset words from the cell index and makes one indirect call with the current position.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:6660
name: swap_pointer_pair_and_update
description: Swaps two stored pointers, copies the first two words of the new target into two fields, runs three indirect routines on those fields, writes the second word back and makes one final indirect call.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:66B6
name: open_input_device_request
description: Opens the input device through indirect library calls, allocating a request block and attaching a handler buffer. It returns one on success, and on failure releases the request block and returns zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:6766
name: send_device_request_and_release
description: Sets the command code of a stored request block to ten and points it at a buffer, then makes three indirect calls on that block and one indirect call on the stored handle.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:67AC
name: collect_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table selected by a stored index, passes each entry whose flag bit is set to a follow-up routine, then fills any remaining of up to twelve slots with alternating constants and marks them empty.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:68CA
name: place_indexed_entry_value
description: Maps a stored index to a value using special cases for two indices and a lookup table, then makes a series of indirect calls that place the value at positions derived from the parameters, choosing one of two constants by the low bit of the first parameter.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:6A66
name: dispatch_state_and_event
description: Dispatches on a stored state word and an event code. In the first state it fills a table of 31 rows with computed values and moves to the next state, while other event codes select text messages and adjust counters.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:7ED2
name: retry_poll_up_to_limit
description: Clears a counter and repeatedly calls a routine with a stored coordinate pair until it returns five or the counter reaches twenty-five. If the limit was hit, it makes one indirect call and then calls the state dispatch routine with five.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:7F18
name: notify_then_dispatch_event_five
description: Makes one indirect call with the constant one and a stored coordinate pair, then calls the state dispatch routine with five.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:7F40
name: set_state_and_dispatch
description: If a status bit is clear, stores the parameter as the current state word, clears a companion byte and calls the state dispatch routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:7F60
name: fill_byte_tables_from_source
description: Fills several byte tables in a global block by calling an indirect routine with consecutive index values. Some entries get fixed defaults, and one default depends on whether a stored counter exceeds two.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:800E
name: wait_until_index_reaches_ten
description: Repeatedly calls one routine while a stored index word is below ten, and returns once the index reaches ten.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8022
name: push_changed_entry_fields
description: Compares the selected table entry's six values with cached copies and, for the first value that differs, passes the new value through indirect calls, caches it and returns. If nothing changed, it clears the state of seven slots, makes a final indirect call and sets the index to ten.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:82A0
name: forward_indexed_entry_if_enabled
description: If a status bit is set, makes an indirect call using a table entry selected by the parameter and a value from a second table, with the second argument passed through.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:82E0
name: prepare_buffers_and_select_pointer
description: Passes three 35-byte buffers and one 60-byte buffer to an indirect routine, then selects a pointer from a table using a stored index minus one.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8334
name: store_argument_in_node_field
description: Stores the single stack argument into the field four bytes into the structure that the address register points to.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:833A
name: update_linked_object_positions
description: Walks a linked list of objects, applying each object's offset to its stored position and clamping the result to fixed bounds. Entries with a callback pointer invoke it after their position is updated.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8390
name: advance_linked_entries_clamped
description: Walks a linked list of entries, computing a tile code from the stored position when a flag applies, then adds each entry's offset to its position and clamps the result to fixed bounds, calling a callback when one is set.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:83BC
name: advance_linked_entries_bounded
description: Walks a linked list of entries, taking queued codes from them and computing a tile code from the position when a flag applies. Each entry's position is then offset and clamped to fixed bounds before any callback runs.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:84EA
name: read_ring_buffer_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a 128-entry circular buffer, or zero when the read and write indices are equal, and advances the read index.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8514
name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances a stored 16-bit linear congruential state by multiplying by a fixed multiplier and adding one, then returns a value built from the new state with its bits shifted and masked.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:852C
name: mask_random_with_parameter
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns the bitwise AND of its result with the parameter.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8534
name: pick_random_bit
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns its lowest bit, which is zero or one.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:853E
name: pick_random_two_bits
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns its low two bits, giving a value from zero to three.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8548
name: pick_random_three_bits
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns its low three bits, giving a value from zero to seven.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8552
name: pick_random_six_bits
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns its low six bits, giving a value from zero to 63.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:855C
name: return_random_byte
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator and returns the low byte of its result.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8566
name: combine_random_modulo_parameter
description: Calls the pseudo-random generator, takes its low 16 bits modulo the low 16 bits of the parameter, and returns that remainder in the high word together with the parameter in the low word.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:857A
name: invoke_helper_then_library_call
description: Calls one helper routine, then makes an indirect call through a library base stored in a global slot and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:85A6
name: format_number_as_decimal_text
description: Writes an unsigned number as decimal digits into a ten-byte text buffer from the right, filling unused leading positions with spaces.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:85AE
name: write_decimal_digits_with_padding
description: Writes the decimal digits of a number into a buffer from a passed-in start index moving leftward, and fills the remaining positions with spaces once the number is exhausted.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:85CA
name: clear_buffer_with_spaces
description: Fills a buffer with space characters from a passed-in index down to the start.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:85F6
name: run_nested_callback_sweep
description: Runs three nested loops of fixed counts that call indirect routines on each pass, adds extra calls once the outer counter passes nine, and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:86FA
name: print_string_with_escape_codes
description: Walks a zero-terminated string. Byte value 128 triggers an indirect routine, and other text runs are passed with their lengths to another indirect routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:874E
name: lookup_masked_nibble_at_position
description: Derives a table position from two packed coordinate parameters and stored offsets, then returns the upper nibble of a table entry when a mask built from the parameter bits is set, otherwise zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8756
name: lookup_masked_nibble_from_registers
description: Derives a table position from two packed coordinate values passed in registers and stored offsets, then returns the upper nibble of a table entry when a mask built from the value bits is set, otherwise zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:87EE
name: call_library_then_drop_four
description: Makes an indirect library call through a stored base and then decrements a stored stack pointer by four bytes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8810
name: call_library_then_subtract_block
description: Makes an indirect library call through a stored base, then subtracts a stored length plus four from a stored stack pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8838
name: call_routine_sequence_with_arg
description: Makes one call with a stored argument, then a long unbroken run of calls to other routines with no arguments.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:88F0
name: call_six_routines_in_order
description: Makes six consecutive calls to other routines, with no arguments and no results.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:890A
name: copy_block_to_multiple_buffers
description: Copies 16 iterations of word pairs from a source block, selected by a parameter, into five destination buffers, advancing the destination by eighty bytes per iteration.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8964
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Consists of a bare return with no work, so calling it does nothing.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:896E
name: forward_stored_value_to_routine
description: Passes a stored global value to one routine and returns the input registers unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:89C8
name: forward_value_then_run_sequence
description: Passes a stored value to one routine, then makes a long run of calls to other routines with no arguments, and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8A62
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns, without touching any data itself.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8A70
name: process_map_cell_window
description: Clamps two packed position values to fixed limits, then walks a 9-by-18 window of map cells, looking up each cell's byte in a table and passing the derived address to an indirect routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8B30
name: unpack_five_bitplane_rows
description: Expands packed source bytes through a lookup table into five bitplane words for eight rows, writing each plane's row into five destination arrays and a second copy 40 bytes further on.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8BC8
name: copy_rows_of_four_words
description: Copies eight rows of four 16-bit words from a source block selected by an index into a destination position computed from the arguments, advancing by the row width each time.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8C18
name: compute_tile_pointer_for_position
description: Converts two packed position values to a cell offset by subtracting stored origin offsets and wrapping the cell coordinates, then combines the offset with a looked-up cell code and returns it added to a stored base address.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8C84
name: fill_cell_window_buffer
description: Fills a buffer of 19 rows by 6 columns with cell codes looked up around a position, then stores one more looked-up code at a stored position, adding 256 when a stored level counter is above seven.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8D48
name: decompress_run_length_stream
description: Copies bytes from a stored source pointer into the output. When a flag is set it expands run-length records, where a negative count repeats the next byte; otherwise it copies a fixed number of raw bytes and advances the source pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8DC4
name: scale_value_by_table
description: When the second parameter selects one of eight table entries, multiplies the third parameter by that entry, halves it, adds it to the first parameter and keeps the result within fifteen bits. Otherwise it returns the first parameter unchanged.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8DEE
name: scale_value_with_sign
description: Like the table scaling routine, but keeps the sign bit of the first parameter: when the selector is below eight, it adds the halved table product to the lower fifteen bits and restores the original top bit.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E20
name: copy_bit14_into_bit15
description: Copies bit 14 of the value into bit 15 and returns the result, so the top bit follows the bit below it.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E30
name: clear_top_bit_of_register
description: Returns the register value with its top bit cleared, keeping the low fifteen bits.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E36
name: step_position_toward_target
description: Compares a target position with the stored position and moves the stored x and y by one unit toward it when they differ by more than a small threshold, snapping to a fixed offset from the target when they are far apart.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E6E
name: step_position_from_register_targets
description: Moves the stored x and y positions one step toward target values held in registers, snapping them to a fixed offset from the target when the distance is large.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E7E
name: step_position_by_one_unit
description: Moves the stored x position one unit toward a register value when the difference exceeds twenty, and steps or snaps the stored y position toward another register value.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8E8A
name: nudge_x_and_step_y
description: Increments the stored x position when a register value exceeds twenty, and steps or snaps the stored y position toward a target held in registers.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8EA4
name: step_y_toward_target
description: Steps the stored y position one unit toward a register-held target when the difference exceeds ten, or snaps it to a fixed offset from the target when the difference is large.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8EB4
name: nudge_y_by_one_unit
description: Moves the stored y position by one unit in the direction of a register value when that value lies more than ten away from zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8EC0
name: nudge_y_up_when_positive
description: Increments the stored y position by one when a register value exceeds ten.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8ED6
name: handle_error_message
description: When the parameter is not two, makes three routine calls with fixed arguments, one of them using a global pointer, and the routine references error text.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8F0E
name: classify_position_into_band
description: Looks up a byte from a table by the parameter, then for certain ranges of the parameter overrides it with a small code from three to ten, and returns the result.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8F5A
name: select_direction_code_from_input
description: Reads joystick movement bits or stored coordinates, depending on a mode bit, and maps them to a direction code through a table, calling a handler when the code changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8F6E
name: select_direction_code_from_input
description: Reads joystick movement bits or stored coordinates, depending on a mode bit, and maps them to a direction code through a table, calling a handler when the code changes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:8FC0
name: read_joystick_direction_code
description: Reads the joystick port movement bits from the custom chip register, maps the pair to a direction code through a table and calls a handler when the code changes. While the stick is centred it counts a stored timer down and resets to the neutral code nine when the timer runs out.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9012
name: update_direction_from_timer
description: Subtracts twenty from a stored timer and, when the result falls outside zero to nine, resets the timer and uses neutral code nine. Calls a handler when the resulting code differs from the stored one.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9026
name: set_neutral_direction_code
description: Clears a stored timer and, if the stored direction code is not nine, sets it to nine and calls a handler with nine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9044
name: lookup_with_secondary_check
description: Calls one lookup routine and returns its result, unless that result is a small value other than one, in which case it calls a second lookup. When the second result is also small and not one, the routine returns zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9080
name: combine_five_sources_inverted
description: Loops over rows of words, writing the bitwise inverse of the AND of five source words into a destination word for each position.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9112
name: setup_blitter_for_five_planes
description: Programs the blitter hardware registers for five entries, writing control, mask, modulo and pointer values with offsets taken from a table selected by the parameter, and makes library calls before and after the register writes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:91A2
name: set_blitter_regs
description: Writes a fixed control value and zero to the blitter control and modulo registers, sets the destination pointer and blit size from its two arguments, and returns zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:91CC
name: setup_blitter_masked_planes
description: Programs the blitter for five rows, writing the control registers, first and last word masks, source and destination pointers and modulo values, using a stored shift count and a table, with library calls around the writes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9286
name: program_single_blit_region
description: Programs one blit with a fixed control value, word masks, source and destination pointers and modulo registers, using stored positions and a library call before the writes.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9310
name: program_blit_rows_from_base
description: For five rows, programs the blitter control, mask, modulo and destination registers from a stored table, with each row offset by a multiple of a stored step plus the parameter.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9390
name: program_blit_columns_offset
description: For five entries, programs the blitter control, mask, modulo and destination registers, where each entry's offset is a multiple of a stored step plus the parameter, with a library call before the loop.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9414
name: forward_indirect_call
description: Makes one indirect call through a stored function slot and returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:94F2
name: forward_indirect_call
description: Makes one indirect call through a stored function slot and returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9BEC
name: compute_direction_code_between
description: Works out the signed distances between two positions and their absolute sizes, looks up a direction code from the signs and magnitudes, and stores it in a record field after an adjustment from an indirect call. A reserved lookup result stores a fixed value instead.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9BF6
name: compute_direction_code_between
description: Works out the signed distances between two records and their absolute sizes, looks up a direction code from the signs and magnitudes, and stores it in a record field after an adjustment from an indirect call. A reserved lookup result stores a fixed value instead.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9C32
name: compute_direction_code_from_registers
description: Works out a direction code from signed distances held in registers, using the same sign and magnitude tests and table, and stores it in a record field. A reserved lookup result stores a fixed value instead.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9C40
name: compute_direction_code_from_deltas
description: Works out a direction code from signed distances held in registers and a stored position, using sign and magnitude tests and a table, then stores it in a record field. A reserved lookup result stores a fixed value instead.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9CAA
name: store_direction_from_sum
description: After an indirect call, conditionally negates one value and stores the masked sum of two values into a record field, setting a second field to a fixed code unless a register holds five.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9CB8
name: store_byte_difference
description: Stores the masked difference of two register values into a record field, and when a register does not hold five, stores twelve into an adjacent field.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9CD4
name: apply_hit_and_place_entry
description: Subtracts an amount from an entry's counter field and clamps it at zero, then places a new entry at a randomised offset chosen by a mode argument. Two special entry types skip the update and make a fixed call instead.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9D3A
name: apply_record_hit_and_place
description: Subtracts an amount stored in a record from an entry's counter field and clamps it at zero, places a new entry at a randomised offset chosen by a mode argument, then runs a follow-up check when the entry type qualifies.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9D70
name: subtract_counter_and_place_entry
description: Subtracts a per-record amount from an entry's counter, clamps it at zero, places a new entry at a randomised offset selected by a mode code, and makes a follow-up check when the entry type qualifies.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9DC4
name: place_entry_by_mode
description: Chooses a placement mode from a flag and a mode code, places a new entry with a random offset, then, when the entry type qualifies, runs a follow-up check and a second routine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9DE8
name: place_entry_flag_then_check
description: Chooses between two placement modes from a flag, places a new entry with a random offset, then runs the same type-qualified follow-up check.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9E06
name: place_entry_fixed_then_check
description: Always places a new entry with a random offset in one fixed mode, then runs the type-qualified follow-up check.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9E7A
name: count_entry_types_and_notify
description: Counts entries of two particular types within a range of records, then, when a stored counter is positive and below a threshold, makes calls with those counts and a global pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9E8A
name: count_entry_types_and_notify
description: Counts entries of two particular types within a range of records, then, when a stored counter is positive and below a threshold, makes calls with those counts and a global pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9EA0
name: count_entry_types_and_notify
description: Counts entries of two particular types within a range of records, then, when a stored counter is positive and below a threshold, makes calls with those counts and a global pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9EB8
name: count_entry_types_and_notify
description: Counts entries of two particular types within a range of records, then, when a stored counter is positive and below a threshold, makes calls with those counts and a global pointer.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9EE4
name: report_entry_counts_and_status
description: Reports counts of two kinds of entries with text messages when a stored counter is below fifty and each count is non-zero, then runs a closing status routine when a flag is set. One message string is the text Bravely done.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9EFC
name: report_fled_or_defeated_counts
description: Reports counts of fleeing and defeated foes with the matching message text when a stored counter is below fifty, then runs a closing status routine when a flag is set.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:9FA2
name: check_proximity_to_other_entries
description: Returns sixteen when a position lies within about eleven columns and nine rows of another live entry, skipping the given index and the first slot, and zero when none is close. It first makes an indirect check whose result is handled for the given index.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A010
name: check_record_proximity_to_entries
description: Returns sixteen when a record's position lies within about eleven columns and nine rows of another live entry, skipping the record's own slot and the first slot, and zero when none is close.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A016
name: check_record_proximity_from_index
description: Scans entries upward from a starting index and returns sixteen when the record lies within about eleven columns and nine rows of one of them, otherwise zero.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A0BA
name: scan_for_entry_within_reach
description: Scans entries for one whose position lies within about ten columns and eight rows of the record, returning sixteen when one is found and zero when none remain.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A0CE
name: find_nearest_entry_index
description: Scans entries from the second slot up to a stored limit and records the index whose distance value is smallest in a stored global. It returns the best value found, skipping entries of one special type under a condition.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A0DE
name: find_nearest_entry_for_record
description: Scans entries from the first slot up to a stored limit, computing a distance for each, and stores the smallest distance in the record and its index in a stored global, then returns that smallest distance.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A142
name: compute_approximate_distance
description: Takes the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two records. When neither exceeds twice the other, it returns the result of an indirect routine, otherwise it returns the horizontal difference.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A1C0
name: call_pair_when_ratio_small
description: When one value is at most twice another, makes two indirect calls, otherwise does nothing.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A1CC
name: call_indirect_pair
description: Makes two indirect calls in sequence with no arguments and returns.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A1DE
name: try_move_entry_to_position
description: Computes a new position for an entry from two indirect transformations of its stored coordinates, tests it with a helper routine, and stores the new position only when the test returns zero. Returns one when the move was accepted.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A26C
name: store_entry_position
description: Stores two register values as the position of the entry selected by an index in a record field, and returns one.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A290
name: submit_indexed_frame_pair
description: Looks up a four-byte frame descriptor for the given index and passes it to an indirect routine with a fixed set of arguments, then does the same with a second descriptor for indices below nine.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A368
name: build_palette_table_from_level
description: Builds a 32-entry table of colour values packed as red, green and blue nibbles, using a stage-dependent base and a clamped level argument, and adds small random boosts when the mode argument is set. It then loads the table through an indirect call with 32 entries.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A56E
name: randomize_palette_frames
description: Repeats 32 times: fills palette entries one to thirty-one with random values bounded by 4095, loads them through an indirect call and then makes a second indirect call with a delay argument of one.

key: Faery Tale Adventure, The/Faery Tale Adventure, The.adf:FMAIN:0:A5CA
name: dispatch_queued_event_code
description: Pops the next code from a 32-entry circular queue when one is pending and dispatches it through a switch. Some codes show message text with computed values, others call indirect routines with stored positions or counts, and an empty queue makes a single indirect call.
